h1.en: How Much Does an Abortion Cost in Virginia in 2026?
h1.es: Cuanto Cuesta un Aborto en Virginia en 2026?

subhero.en: Abortion costs range from $350 to $2,600 in Virginia in 2026, depending on the method (medication or surgical), gestational age, and whether care is provided at an independent clinic or a hospital outpatient department. Virginia is the only Southern state without a gestational ban before 26 weeks and 6 days, meaning most abortion methods remain available statewide. Medication abortion (the pill) is available through telehealth and in-person clinics for pregnancies up to 10 to 12 weeks and typically costs $350 to $650. Surgical abortion costs $600 to $2,600 depending on how far along the pregnancy is.
subhero.es: El aborto cuesta entre $350 y $2,600 en Virginia en 2026, dependiendo del metodo (medicamento o quirurgico), la edad gestacional y si la atencion se brinda en una clinica independiente o en un departamento ambulatorio del hospital. Virginia es el unico estado del Sur sin una prohibicion gestacional antes de las 26 semanas y 6 dias. El aborto con medicamentos (la pastilla) esta disponible por telehealth y en clinicas presenciales para embarazos de hasta 10 a 12 semanas y cuesta tipicamente entre $350 y $650. El aborto quirurgico cuesta entre $600 y $2,600 segun la semana de embarazo.

quickAnswer.en: In 2026, abortion in Virginia costs $350 to $650 for medication abortion (pill), $600 to $900 for first-trimester surgical abortion, and $900 to $2,600 for second-trimester surgical procedures, with costs rising by gestational week. Virginia has no state law banning abortion before 26 weeks and 6 days. Medicare and Virginia Medicaid (Cardinal Care) cover abortion only in narrow Hyde Amendment exceptions: rape, incest, life or health endangerment, and documented fetal anomaly. Virginia ACA-compliant marketplace plans are not required to cover abortion, though some voluntarily do. Under the No Surprises Act, any Virginia clinic or hospital must provide a written Good Faith Estimate before your appointment if you are paying out of pocket.
quickAnswer.es: En 2026, el aborto en Virginia cuesta entre $350 y $650 para aborto con medicamentos (pastilla), $600 a $900 para aborto quirurgico en el primer trimestre, y $900 a $2,600 para procedimientos quirurgicos en el segundo trimestre, con costos que aumentan por semana gestacional. Virginia no tiene ley estatal que prohiba el aborto antes de las 26 semanas y 6 dias. Medicare y Medicaid de Virginia (Cardinal Care) cubren el aborto solo en los casos excepcionales de la Enmienda Hyde: violacion, incesto, peligro para la vida o la salud de la madre, y anomalia fetal documentada. Bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas, cualquier clinica u hospital de Virginia debe proporcionar un Estimado de Buena Fe por escrito antes de su cita si paga de su propio bolsillo.

introParagraphs.en: Virginia is the only state in the South without a gestational ban at 6, 12, or 15 weeks as of 2026. Abortion remains legal in Virginia through 26 weeks and 6 days under current state statute (Code of Virginia 18.2-74). After the second trimester, three physicians must certify that the pregnancy threatens the life or substantially and irremediably impairs the mental or physical health of the patient. A November 2026 ballot measure, the Right to Reproductive Freedom Amendment backed by Governor Spanberger, would embed these protections in the state constitution; a competing amendment would restrict abortion to 12 weeks or fewer except for medical emergencies and rape or incest. Neither amendment changes the current legal landscape before voters decide in November 2026.
introParagraphs.es: Virginia es el unico estado del Sur sin una prohibicion gestacional a las 6, 12 o 15 semanas a partir de 2026. El aborto sigue siendo legal en Virginia hasta las 26 semanas y 6 dias bajo el estatuto estatal actual (Codigo de Virginia 18.2-74). Despues del segundo trimestre, tres medicos deben certificar que el embarazo amenaza la vida o perjudica sustancial e irremediablemente la salud mental o fisica de la paciente. Una medida electoral de noviembre de 2026 podria cambiar este panorama, pero ninguna enmienda modifica el marco legal actual antes de que los votantes decidan.

introParagraphs.en: Virginia Planned Parenthood clinics (Virginia League for Planned Parenthood and Planned Parenthood South Atlantic) operate in Virginia Beach, Richmond, Roanoke, and Northern Virginia, offering medication abortion by telehealth for Virginia residents up to 10 weeks gestation, and procedural abortion up to 21 weeks and 6 days in-person. Independent reproductive health clinics include Falls Church Healthcare Center (Northern Virginia), which provides care through later gestational ages, and the Capital Women's Care network. Prices at independent clinics are typically lower than at hospital outpatient departments, where facility fees add substantially to the total bill. Patients comparing options should ask each provider for an itemized Good Faith Estimate that separates the procedure, anesthesia, lab work, and follow-up visit.
introParagraphs.es: Las clinicas de Planned Parenthood de Virginia ofrecen aborto con medicamentos por telehealth para residentes de Virginia hasta las 10 semanas de gestacion, y aborto procedural hasta las 21 semanas y 6 dias en persona. Las clinicas independientes de salud reproductiva incluyen Falls Church Healthcare Center (norte de Virginia) y la red Capital Women's Care. Los precios en clinicas independientes son tipicamente mas bajos que en los departamentos ambulatorios de hospitales. Los pacientes que comparan opciones deben pedir a cada proveedor un Estimado de Buena Fe detallado que separe el procedimiento, la anestesia, los analisis de laboratorio y la visita de seguimiento.

introParagraphs.en: This guide covers what abortion costs in Virginia in 2026, the billing distinction between medication abortion and surgical abortion, what Virginia Medicaid (Cardinal Care) covers, what Medicare and ACA-compliant marketplace plans cover, how to request a Good Faith Estimate under the No Surprises Act, and which Virginia abortion funds provide financial assistance. For Medicaid eligibility in Virginia, see the linked CoverVA resource at coverva.dmas.virginia.gov. For ACA marketplace coverage rules nationally, KFF publishes state-by-state abortion coverage data at kff.org.
introParagraphs.es: Esta guia cubre lo que cuesta el aborto en Virginia en 2026, la distincion entre aborto con medicamentos y aborto quirurgico, que cubre Medicaid de Virginia (Cardinal Care), que cubren Medicare y los planes ACA, como solicitar un Estimado de Buena Fe bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas, y que fondos de aborto de Virginia ofrecen asistencia financiera.

explanationParagraphs.en: Virginia abortion cost in 2026 is shaped heavily by where the procedure takes place. Independent reproductive health clinics operate with lower overhead than hospital outpatient departments and compete directly on self-pay pricing. A first-trimester surgical abortion at a Planned Parenthood Virginia location or Falls Church Healthcare Center runs $600 to $900, while the same procedure billed through a hospital outpatient department can reach $1,500 to $3,500. The chargemaster rate at a hospital outpatient department includes facility fees, nursing staffing models, and overhead costs that independent clinics do not carry. Virginia law also requires that second-trimester abortions (after the first trimester) be performed in a licensed hospital or similarly licensed facility, which can narrow the low-cost clinic options for some patients in the 13 to 26 week range.
explanationParagraphs.es: El costo del aborto en Virginia en 2026 esta fuertemente determinado por el lugar donde se realiza el procedimiento. Las clinicas independientes de salud reproductiva operan con menos gastos generales que los departamentos ambulatorios de hospitales y compiten directamente en precios de pago propio. Un aborto quirurgico en el primer trimestre en una ubicacion de Planned Parenthood Virginia o Falls Church Healthcare Center cuesta entre $600 y $900, mientras que el mismo procedimiento facturado en un departamento ambulatorio del hospital puede llegar a $1,500 a $3,500. El precio de lista (chargemaster) en un departamento ambulatorio del hospital incluye cargos de instalacion, modelos de personal y costos generales que las clinicas independientes no tienen.

explanationParagraphs.en: Medication abortion cost in Virginia is lower because the clinical encounter is simpler: an office visit or telehealth consultation, a prescription for mifepristone (S0190) and misoprostol (S0191), and a follow-up confirmation visit or test. The bundled service code S0199 covers the consultation and associated services but not the medications, which are billed separately. Online telehealth providers serving Virginia patients charge $350 to $500 for the complete medication abortion service; in-person clinic visits at Planned Parenthood Virginia run approximately $580 to $600 for medication abortion including medications. Hospital outpatient medication abortion billing, if available, runs $800 to $1,500 due to facility fees.
explanationParagraphs.es: El costo del aborto con medicamentos en Virginia es mas bajo porque el encuentro clinico es mas simple: una visita o consulta de telehealth, una receta de mifepristona y misoprostol, y una visita de seguimiento o prueba de confirmacion. Los proveedores de telehealth en linea que atienden a pacientes de Virginia cobran de $350 a $500 por el servicio completo de aborto con medicamentos; las visitas presenciales en clinicas de Planned Parenthood Virginia cuestan aproximadamente $580 a $600 incluyendo medicamentos.

explanationParagraphs.en: Virginia patients seeking self-pay abortion care should compare quotes from multiple clinic types before scheduling. Falls Church Healthcare Center in Northern Virginia offers financial assistance programs and publishes fees by gestational week on its website. The Blue Ridge Abortion Fund and Richmond Reproductive Freedom Project provide direct financial assistance to Virginia patients who cannot cover the full out-of-pocket cost. Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs) in Virginia offer sliding-scale fees for many reproductive health services, though not all FQHCs perform abortions. For patients at or below 100% of the federal poverty level, some may pay $0 for services at an FQHC; link to the federal poverty level chart is below for reference.
explanationParagraphs.es: Los pacientes de Virginia que buscan atencion de aborto de pago propio deben comparar cotizaciones de varios tipos de clinicas antes de programar. El Blue Ridge Abortion Fund y el Richmond Reproductive Freedom Project proporcionan asistencia financiera directa a pacientes de Virginia que no pueden cubrir el costo completo de bolsillo. Los Centros de Salud Calificados Federalmente (FQHC) en Virginia ofrecen tarifas en escala movil para muchos servicios de salud reproductiva.

paragraphs.en: Medicare coverage of abortion is restricted by the Hyde Amendment to three narrow federal exceptions: when a pregnancy results from rape or incest, or when the pregnancy would, as certified by a physician, place the patient in danger of death or substantially and irremediably impair mental or physical health. Original Medicare Part B covers abortion procedures performed in an outpatient setting under these narrow exceptions only, subject to the standard 20% coinsurance after the 2026 Part B deductible of $283. Medicare Advantage plans are not required to cover abortion beyond the Hyde exceptions, and most do not. Medigap supplemental policies pay the 20% Original Medicare coinsurance after the deductible is met, but they do not expand the services covered. For the vast majority of Medicare beneficiaries seeking elective abortion, Medicare does not cover the cost.
paragraphs.es: La cobertura de Medicare para el aborto esta restringida por la Enmienda Hyde a tres casos excepcionales: cuando un embarazo resulta de violacion o incesto, o cuando el embarazo pondria en peligro de muerte a la paciente o perjudicaria sustancial e irremediablemente su salud mental o fisica. Medicare Original Parte B cubre procedimientos de aborto realizados en un entorno ambulatorio bajo estas excepciones, sujeto al coseguro estandar del 20% despues del deducible de la Parte B de $283 para 2026. Los planes Medicare Advantage no estan obligados a cubrir el aborto mas alla de las excepciones Hyde, y la mayoria no lo hace. Las polizas suplementarias Medigap pagan el coseguro del 20% de Medicare Original despues de cumplir el deducible, pero no amplian los servicios cubiertos.

paragraphs.en: Virginia Medicaid (Cardinal Care) follows the Hyde Amendment and covers abortion only in cases of rape, incest, life or health endangerment, or documented fetal anomaly. Virginia's Department of Health (VDH) operates a separate State-Funded Abortion program that reimburses providers at Medicaid rates for these eligible cases. Patients must be Virginia residents with Medicaid eligibility. For rape and incest cases, the pregnancy must be reported to law enforcement or a VDH local health district. For fetal anomaly cases, the provider submits supporting medical documentation (ultrasound, amniocentesis, or bloodwork) along with a completed SFA-12 form. The provider submits claims to VDH's Reproductive Health Unit within six months of the procedure. Patients who believe their case may qualify can ask their provider or contact DMAS (coverva.dmas.virginia.gov) before the procedure.
paragraphs.es: Medicaid de Virginia (Cardinal Care) sigue la Enmienda Hyde y cubre el aborto solo en casos de violacion, incesto, peligro para la vida o la salud, o anomalia fetal documentada. El Departamento de Salud de Virginia (VDH) opera un programa separado de Aborto Financiado por el Estado que reembolsa a los proveedores a las tarifas de Medicaid para estos casos elegibles. Las pacientes deben ser residentes de Virginia con elegibilidad para Medicaid. Para casos de violacion e incesto, el embarazo debe reportarse a las autoridades. Las pacientes que creen que su caso puede calificar pueden preguntar a su proveedor o contactar a DMAS antes del procedimiento.

paragraphs.en: ACA-compliant plans sold through Virginia's marketplace are not required by state law to include abortion coverage. Virginia falls into the category of states that are silent on the issue, leaving coverage decisions to individual insurers. As of 2026, at least one ACA plan available in Virginia's marketplace does include abortion coverage, but the majority do not. Federal law prohibits the use of any premium tax credits toward the portion of a plan premium attributable to abortion coverage; insurers that include abortion coverage must segregate premium payments and billing accordingly. If you are on an ACA-compliant plan and are considering an abortion, review your plan's Summary of Benefits and Coverage document or call the insurer's member services line before scheduling.
paragraphs.es: Los planes ACA que se venden a traves del mercado de Virginia no estan obligados por ley estatal a incluir cobertura para el aborto. Virginia cae en la categoria de estados que son silenciosos sobre el tema, dejando las decisiones de cobertura a los aseguradores individuales. A partir de 2026, al menos un plan ACA disponible en el mercado de Virginia incluye cobertura para el aborto, pero la mayoria no lo hace. Si tiene un plan ACA y esta considerando un aborto, revise el documento Resumen de Beneficios y Cobertura de su plan o llame a la linea de servicios para miembros del asegurador antes de programar.

paragraphs.en: Under the No Surprises Act, effective January 1, 2022, any patient in Virginia who is uninsured or choosing to pay out of pocket has the legal right to a written Good Faith Estimate from the provider before the abortion procedure. For an abortion appointment scheduled at least 10 business days out, the provider must furnish the Good Faith Estimate at least 3 business days before service. For an appointment scheduled 3 to 9 business days out, the Good Faith Estimate must arrive at least 1 business day before service. The Good Faith Estimate must include itemized expected charges, procedure codes (such as S0199 for medication abortion services, or the applicable surgical code), the provider's name and NPI, and total expected cost. The federal consumer resource is at cms.gov/nosurprises.
paragraphs.es: Bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas, vigente desde el 1 de enero de 2022, cualquier paciente en Virginia que no tenga seguro o elija pagar de su bolsillo tiene el derecho legal a un Estimado de Buena Fe escrito del proveedor antes del procedimiento de aborto. Para una cita programada con al menos 10 dias habiles de anticipacion, el proveedor debe proporcionar el Estimado de Buena Fe al menos 3 dias habiles antes del servicio. El recurso federal para consumidores esta en cms.gov/nosurprises.

paragraphs.en: To request a Good Faith Estimate for an abortion in Virginia in 2026, follow these five steps: (1) Call the clinic or hospital and identify yourself as self-pay or uninsured, or state that you want to compare cash-pay pricing before deciding whether to use insurance. (2) Ask for a written Good Faith Estimate that itemizes the procedure fee, sedation or anesthesia, laboratory costs, any required ultrasound, and the follow-up visit or medication for a surgical procedure. (3) Provide your gestational age and any specific services you expect, such as IV sedation versus local anesthesia, so the estimate reflects your actual care plan. (4) Confirm the timing: if your appointment is at least 10 business days away, the estimate is due 3 business days before service; if scheduled in 3 to 9 business days, it is due 1 business day before. (5) Keep the written Good Faith Estimate. If your final bill exceeds the estimate by $400 or more, you have 120 days from the bill date to file a patient-provider dispute resolution claim through the federal portal at cms.gov/nosurprisesact.
paragraphs.es: Para solicitar un Estimado de Buena Fe para un aborto en Virginia en 2026, siga estos cinco pasos: (1) Llame a la clinica u hospital e identifiquese como paciente de pago propio o sin seguro. (2) Solicite un Estimado de Buena Fe escrito que detalle el costo del procedimiento, sedacion o anestesia, costos de laboratorio, cualquier ultrasonido requerido y la visita de seguimiento. (3) Proporcione su edad gestacional y cualquier servicio especifico que espere recibir. (4) Confirme el tiempo: si su cita es al menos 10 dias habiles despues, el estimado es debido 3 dias habiles antes del servicio. (5) Conserve el Estimado de Buena Fe escrito. Si su factura final excede el estimado en $400 o mas, tiene 120 dias desde la fecha de la factura para presentar una reclamacion de resolucion de disputas entre paciente y proveedor a traves del portal federal en cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

paragraphs.en: A Good Faith Estimate for an abortion in Virginia is not a guaranteed final bill. Common reasons the actual charges exceed the estimate include: additional ultrasound time needed to confirm gestational age at the time of service, pathology specimen fees for tissue sent for histological confirmation, IV sedation or anesthesia upgraded from local anesthesia due to patient preference or clinical need, and follow-up visit or emergency contact charges not reflected in the original estimate. If the final bill is $400 or more above the Good Faith Estimate, the patient has 120 days from the bill date to file a patient-provider dispute resolution (PPDR) claim at cms.gov/nosurprisesact. Virginia providers are covered by the federal No Surprises Act; there is no state-level exemption for reproductive health services.
paragraphs.es: Un Estimado de Buena Fe para un aborto en Virginia no es una factura final garantizada. Las razones comunes por las que los cargos reales superan el estimado incluyen: tiempo adicional de ultrasonido necesario para confirmar la edad gestacional, cargos por muestras de patologia, sedacion IV o anestesia actualizada desde anestesia local, y cargos de visita de seguimiento no incluidos en el estimado original. Si la factura final es $400 o mas por encima del Estimado de Buena Fe, la paciente tiene 120 dias desde la fecha de la factura para presentar una reclamacion de resolucion de disputas en cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

items.en: Gestational age at time of procedure: Virginia abortion cost in 2026 rises roughly $100 to $300 per additional week into the second trimester. A 6-week medication abortion costs $350 to $550; a 20-week D&E costs $1,500 to $2,600 at an independent clinic.
items.es: Edad gestacional al momento del procedimiento: el costo del aborto en Virginia en 2026 aumenta aproximadamente $100 a $300 por cada semana adicional en el segundo trimestre.

items.en: Procedure type: medication abortion (the pill) is less expensive than surgical aspiration, which is less expensive than D&E (dilation and evacuation). Medication abortion is typically only available through 10 to 12 weeks gestational age.
items.es: Tipo de procedimiento: el aborto con medicamentos (pastilla) es menos costoso que la aspiracion quirurgica, que a su vez es menos costosa que el LEC (legrado por aspiracion y evacuacion). El aborto con medicamentos generalmente solo esta disponible hasta las 10 a 12 semanas de edad gestacional.

items.en: Site of service: independent reproductive health clinics charge 2 to 3 times less than hospital outpatient departments for the same procedure in 2026. The chargemaster rate at a hospital adds facility fees not present at an independent clinic. Always call ahead and ask for the itemized self-pay cash price.
items.es: Sitio de servicio: las clinicas independientes de salud reproductiva cobran 2 a 3 veces menos que los departamentos ambulatorios de hospitales por el mismo procedimiento en 2026. Llame con anticipacion y solicite el precio de pago en efectivo detallado.

items.en: Independent clinic self-pay cash bundles: Virginia independent reproductive health clinics typically publish flat self-pay rates that bundle the procedure, sedation, and basic lab into one price. Planned Parenthood Virginia League and Falls Church Healthcare Center both offer sliding-scale discounts for patients who cannot pay the full posted rate. Ask specifically: 'What is your all-inclusive cash price and do you offer income-based discounts?'
items.es: Paquetes de pago en efectivo de clinicas independientes: las clinicas independientes de salud reproductiva de Virginia tipicamente publican tarifas planas de pago propio que agrupan el procedimiento, la sedacion y el laboratorio basico en un precio. Tanto Planned Parenthood Virginia League como Falls Church Healthcare Center ofrecen descuentos en escala movil para pacientes que no pueden pagar la tarifa completa publicada.

items.en: Hospital chargemaster discount ask: if you are uninsured and scheduled at a hospital outpatient department, most Virginia hospitals publish a self-pay discount policy of 20 to 50 percent off the chargemaster rate. Some hospitals apply this automatically when you identify as uninsured; others require an explicit written request. Always ask before the appointment.
items.es: Descuento del precio de lista hospitalario: si no tiene seguro y esta programado en un departamento ambulatorio del hospital, la mayoria de los hospitales de Virginia publican una politica de descuento de pago propio del 20 al 50 por ciento del precio de lista. Algunos aplican esto automaticamente cuando se identifica como sin seguro; otros requieren una solicitud escrita explicita.

items.en: Sliding-scale Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs): FQHCs in Virginia offer sliding-scale fees based on household size and income. For patients at or below 100 percent of the 2026 federal poverty level, some services may be $0. Not all FQHCs in Virginia provide abortion services, so call ahead to confirm scope of services before scheduling.
items.es: Centros de Salud Calificados Federalmente (FQHC) con escala movil: los FQHC en Virginia ofrecen tarifas en escala movil basadas en el tamano del hogar y los ingresos. Para pacientes en o por debajo del 100 por ciento del nivel de pobreza federal de 2026, algunos servicios pueden ser $0. No todos los FQHC de Virginia brindan servicios de aborto, por lo que llame con anticipacion para confirmar el alcance de los servicios.

items.en: Virginia abortion funds: the Blue Ridge Abortion Fund, Richmond Reproductive Freedom Project, and Hampton Roads Reproductive Justice League provide direct financial assistance to Virginia patients who cannot cover the full out-of-pocket cost. These organizations cover partial or full procedure costs and may also help with travel, lodging, and childcare. Contact them as early as possible as funds are limited.
items.es: Fondos de aborto de Virginia: el Blue Ridge Abortion Fund, el Richmond Reproductive Freedom Project y el Hampton Roads Reproductive Justice League proporcionan asistencia financiera directa a pacientes de Virginia que no pueden cubrir el costo completo de bolsillo. Estas organizaciones cubren costos parciales o totales del procedimiento y pueden ayudar con transporte, alojamiento y cuidado de ninos.

items.en: Insurance coverage variability: Virginia ACA-compliant plans are not required to cover abortion, and most do not. Employer-sponsored plans vary; some large Virginia employers and federal government plans voluntarily cover abortion as a benefit. Call your insurer's member services line before scheduling to confirm whether abortion services are covered, at what cost-sharing level, and whether prior authorization is required.
items.es: Variabilidad de la cobertura de seguro: los planes ACA de Virginia no estan obligados a cubrir el aborto, y la mayoria no lo hace. Los planes de empleadores varian; algunos grandes empleadores de Virginia y planes del gobierno federal cubren voluntariamente el aborto como beneficio. Llame a la linea de servicios para miembros de su asegurador antes de programar para confirmar si los servicios de aborto estan cubiertos.

intro.en: Abortion billing in Virginia can include unexpected line items, especially when a procedure is billed at a hospital rather than an independent clinic. Check for these common errors before paying any bill:
intro.es: La facturacion del aborto en Virginia puede incluir cargos inesperados, especialmente cuando un procedimiento se factura en un hospital en lugar de una clinica independiente. Verifique estos errores comunes antes de pagar cualquier factura:

items.en: Separate anesthesiologist or CRNA bill arriving weeks after the procedure: the No Surprises Act may protect you if the anesthesia provider was at an in-network facility but billed out-of-network. Do not pay before verifying the network status.
items.es: Factura separada de anestesiologo o CRNA que llega semanas despues del procedimiento: la Ley de No Sorpresas puede protegerla si el proveedor de anestesia estaba en una instalacion dentro de la red pero facturo fuera de la red. No pague antes de verificar el estado de la red.

items.en: Pathology laboratory fee billed separately after a surgical procedure: tissue sent for histological analysis generates a separate lab bill. This fee should have appeared on your Good Faith Estimate if pathology was anticipated.
items.es: Cargo de laboratorio de patologia facturado por separado despues de un procedimiento quirurgico: el tejido enviado para analisis histologico genera una factura de laboratorio separada. Este cargo deberia haber aparecido en su Estimado de Buena Fe si se anticipaba la patologia.

items.en: Hospital outpatient facility fee billed when the procedure was performed at an affiliated independent clinic: the billing entity may differ from the physical location. If the claim shows a hospital outpatient rate for a procedure you had at a freestanding clinic, dispute the facility designation.
items.es: Cargo de instalacion del hospital ambulatorio facturado cuando el procedimiento se realizo en una clinica independiente afiliada: verifique si la entidad de facturacion difiere de la ubicacion fisica. Si el reclamo muestra una tarifa ambulatoria del hospital para un procedimiento realizado en una clinica independiente, dispute la designacion de la instalacion.

items.en: Ultrasound billed twice: once as part of the abortion package and again as a separate diagnostic charge. An ultrasound performed to confirm gestational age as part of abortion care should not be billed as a standalone diagnostic imaging encounter.
items.es: Ultrasonido facturado dos veces: una vez como parte del paquete de aborto y otra vez como cargo diagnostico separado. Un ultrasonido realizado para confirmar la edad gestacional como parte de la atencion de aborto no debe facturarse como un encuentro de imagen diagnostica independiente.

items.en: Blood Rh typing billed as a separate laboratory encounter: Rh factor testing is routinely performed before abortion for patients who may need Rh immunoglobulin. This should be included in the Good Faith Estimate and should not appear as a surprise separate lab charge.
items.es: Tipificacion de sangre Rh facturada como encuentro de laboratorio separado: la prueba del factor Rh se realiza rutinariamente antes del aborto. Esto deberia estar incluido en el Estimado de Buena Fe y no deberia aparecer como un cargo separado sorpresa.

Keep the written Good Faith Estimate after receiving it. If your final bill exceeds the estimate by $400 or more, you have 120 days from the bill date to file a patient-provider dispute resolution (PPDR) claim through the federal portal at cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

en.question: How much does an abortion cost without insurance in Virginia in 2026?
en.answer: Without insurance in Virginia in 2026, medication abortion (the pill) costs $350 to $650 depending on whether you use telehealth or visit a clinic in person. First-trimester surgical abortion costs $600 to $900 at an independent clinic. Second-trimester surgical procedures range from $900 to $2,600 at independent clinics, rising with each additional gestational week. Hospital outpatient departments charge significantly more, often 2 to 3 times the independent clinic rate, because of facility fees. Always request a written itemized Good Faith Estimate before your appointment.

en.question: Does Medicare or Virginia Medicaid cover abortion in 2026?
en.answer: Medicare (Original Medicare Part B, Medicare Advantage, and Medigap) covers abortion only in the narrow Hyde Amendment exceptions: rape, incest, or when the pregnancy threatens the patient's life or health. Virginia Medicaid (Cardinal Care) follows the same Hyde exceptions and also covers abortion when there is a documented incapacitating fetal anomaly. Virginia's Department of Health operates a separate State-Funded Abortion program for Medicaid-eligible patients who qualify under these exceptions. Patients who may qualify can contact their provider or DMAS (coverva.dmas.virginia.gov) before the procedure.

en.question: How do I request a Good Faith Estimate for an abortion in Virginia?
en.answer: Under the No Surprises Act (effective January 2022), any Virginia provider must give you a written Good Faith Estimate if you are paying out of pocket. Call the clinic, identify yourself as self-pay, and ask for an itemized estimate covering the procedure fee by gestational age, sedation, lab fees, ultrasound, and follow-up care. If your appointment is 10 or more business days away, the estimate is due 3 business days before service. If scheduled 3 to 9 business days out, it is due 1 business day before. Keep the written estimate. If the final bill exceeds it by $400 or more, you have 120 days to file a dispute at cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

en.question: What is the No Surprises Act and does it apply to abortion services in Virginia?
en.answer: The No Surprises Act took effect January 1, 2022, and applies to all healthcare providers and facilities nationwide, including reproductive health clinics and hospitals in Virginia performing abortion services. The law requires providers to give uninsured or self-pay patients a written Good Faith Estimate of expected charges before scheduled care. There is no exemption for abortion or reproductive health services. If an out-of-network provider delivers care at an in-network facility without your consent, the No Surprises Act limits your cost-sharing to in-network rates. The federal consumer resource is at cms.gov/nosurprises.

en.question: How do I get a written cash-pay quote for an abortion in Virginia?
en.answer: Call any Virginia abortion provider before scheduling and say: 'I am paying out of pocket. What is your all-inclusive cash price for a [medication abortion / surgical abortion at X weeks]?' Ask whether the price includes sedation, lab work, ultrasound, and the follow-up visit. Ask whether the clinic offers income-based sliding-scale fees. Planned Parenthood Virginia League and Falls Church Healthcare Center both offer published pricing and income-based discounts. Get the quote in writing as a Good Faith Estimate before your appointment. Compare the cash price against your insurance deductible or copay if you have coverage before deciding which to use.

en.question: Can I negotiate an abortion bill after the fact in Virginia?
en.answer: Yes. If your final bill exceeds the written Good Faith Estimate by $400 or more, you have the right to file a patient-provider dispute resolution (PPDR) claim within 120 days of the bill date through the federal portal at cms.gov/nosurprisesact. Even without a Good Faith Estimate overage, most Virginia providers will negotiate a reduction for cash-pay-now offers, typically 20 to 40 percent below the billed amount. Contact the billing department, explain you are uninsured or self-pay, and ask about a financial hardship discount or payment plan. Virginia abortion funds (Blue Ridge Abortion Fund, Richmond Reproductive Freedom Project) may also help cover outstanding balances.

en.question: What is the difference between a hospital outpatient and an independent clinic abortion cost in Virginia?
en.answer: In Virginia in 2026, an independent reproductive health clinic charges $600 to $900 for a first-trimester surgical abortion, while a hospital outpatient department charges $1,500 to $3,500 for the same procedure. The hospital's higher chargemaster rate includes facility overhead, nursing staffing models, and provider-based billing that independent clinics do not carry. Medication abortion at an independent clinic runs $350 to $650; at a hospital outpatient department it can exceed $1,000. The procedure quality is equivalent. Ask explicitly whether the provider bills as an independent clinic or a hospital outpatient department before scheduling.

en.question: Does Virginia ACA insurance cover abortion in 2026?
en.answer: Virginia does not have a state law requiring or prohibiting abortion coverage in ACA-compliant marketplace plans. Coverage is left to individual insurers. As of 2026, at least one plan on Virginia's marketplace includes abortion coverage, but most do not. Federal premium tax credits cannot be applied to the portion of a premium attributable to abortion coverage. If you have an ACA-compliant plan and want to know whether abortion is covered, review the plan's Summary of Benefits and Coverage document or call member services. Employer-sponsored plans also vary; some large Virginia employers and federal government plans voluntarily cover abortion.

en.question: What is the difference between medication abortion and surgical abortion in Virginia?
en.answer: Medication abortion (the pill) uses mifepristone followed by misoprostol to end a pregnancy and is available in Virginia through 10 to 12 weeks of gestation, either via telehealth or an in-person clinic visit. The 2026 cost is $350 to $650 in Virginia. Surgical abortion uses aspiration (vacuum aspiration) in the first trimester or dilation and evacuation (D&E) in the second trimester. Surgical procedures are done in a clinic or licensed facility and require local anesthesia or IV sedation. Surgical costs in Virginia range from $600 in the early first trimester to $2,600 at 18 to 22 weeks. Medication abortion carries a small risk of incomplete abortion requiring follow-up aspiration. Both methods are highly effective and widely available in Virginia.

en.question: What financial assistance is available for abortion in Virginia in 2026?
en.answer: Several organizations provide direct financial assistance for abortion in Virginia in 2026. The Blue Ridge Abortion Fund (blueridgeabortionfund.org) has served patients in Virginia since 1989 and provides funding, transportation, and lodging assistance. The Richmond Reproductive Freedom Project (rrfp.net) assists Virginia patients with procedure costs, transportation, lodging, meals, and ultrasounds, serving over 250 patients per year. The Hampton Roads Reproductive Justice League helps patients in southeastern Virginia. Planned Parenthood Virginia League and Falls Church Healthcare Center offer income-based sliding-scale fees. Contact abortion funds early in the process because funds are limited. For low-income patients, Virginia FQHCs may also offer sliding-scale reproductive health services.

es.question: Cuanto cuesta un aborto sin seguro en Virginia en 2026?
es.answer: Sin seguro en Virginia en 2026, el aborto con medicamentos (pastilla) cuesta entre $350 y $650 dependiendo de si usa telehealth o visita una clinica en persona. El aborto quirurgico en el primer trimestre cuesta entre $600 y $900 en una clinica independiente. Los procedimientos quirurgicos del segundo trimestre van de $900 a $2,600 en clinicas independientes, aumentando por semana gestacional adicional. Los departamentos ambulatorios de hospitales cobran significativamente mas, a menudo 2 a 3 veces la tarifa de la clinica independiente. Siempre solicite un Estimado de Buena Fe escrito detallado antes de su cita.

es.question: Cubre Medicare o Medicaid de Virginia el aborto en 2026?
es.answer: Medicare (Medicare Original Parte B, Medicare Advantage y Medigap) cubre el aborto solo en las excepciones limitadas de la Enmienda Hyde: violacion, incesto, o cuando el embarazo amenaza la vida o la salud de la paciente. Medicaid de Virginia (Cardinal Care) sigue las mismas excepciones Hyde y tambien cubre el aborto cuando hay una anomalia fetal incapacitante documentada. El Departamento de Salud de Virginia (VDH) opera un programa separado de Aborto Financiado por el Estado para pacientes con elegibilidad para Medicaid que califican bajo estas excepciones. Las pacientes que puedan calificar pueden contactar a su proveedor o a DMAS (coverva.dmas.virginia.gov) antes del procedimiento.

es.question: Como solicito un Estimado de Buena Fe para un aborto en Virginia?
es.answer: Bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas (vigente desde enero de 2022), cualquier proveedor de Virginia debe darle un Estimado de Buena Fe escrito si paga de su bolsillo. Llame a la clinica, identifiquese como paciente de pago propio y solicite un estimado detallado que incluya el costo del procedimiento por semana gestacional, sedacion, cargos de laboratorio, ultrasonido y atencion de seguimiento. Si su cita es 10 o mas dias habiles despues, el estimado es debido 3 dias habiles antes del servicio. Si esta programada para 3 a 9 dias habiles, es debido 1 dia habil antes. Conserve el estimado escrito. Si la factura final lo supera en $400 o mas, tiene 120 dias para presentar una disputa en cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

es.question: Que es la Ley de No Sorpresas y aplica a los servicios de aborto en Virginia?
es.answer: La Ley de No Sorpresas entro en vigor el 1 de enero de 2022 y aplica a todos los proveedores e instalaciones de salud en todo el pais, incluidas las clinicas de salud reproductiva y hospitales de Virginia que realizan servicios de aborto. La ley requiere que los proveedores den a los pacientes sin seguro o que pagan de su bolsillo un Estimado de Buena Fe escrito de los cargos esperados antes de la atencion programada. No hay exencion para servicios de aborto o salud reproductiva. El recurso federal para consumidores esta en cms.gov/nosurprises.

es.question: Como obtengo una cotizacion de precio de pago en efectivo para un aborto en Virginia?
es.answer: Llame a cualquier proveedor de aborto de Virginia antes de programar y diga: 'Pago de mi propio bolsillo. Cual es su precio de pago en efectivo completo para [aborto con medicamentos / aborto quirurgico a X semanas]?' Pregunte si el precio incluye sedacion, analisis de laboratorio, ultrasonido y la visita de seguimiento. Pregunte si la clinica ofrece tarifas en escala movil basadas en ingresos. Planned Parenthood Virginia League y Falls Church Healthcare Center ofrecen precios publicados y descuentos basados en ingresos. Obtenga la cotizacion por escrito como Estimado de Buena Fe antes de su cita.

es.question: Puedo negociar una factura de aborto despues del procedimiento en Virginia?
es.answer: Si. Si su factura final supera el Estimado de Buena Fe escrito en $400 o mas, tiene derecho a presentar una reclamacion de resolucion de disputas (PPDR) dentro de los 120 dias de la fecha de la factura a traves del portal federal en cms.gov/nosurprisesact. Incluso sin un exceso del Estimado de Buena Fe, la mayoria de los proveedores de Virginia negociaran una reduccion para ofertas de pago en efectivo, tipicamente del 20 al 40 por ciento por debajo del monto facturado. Contacte al departamento de facturacion, explique que no tiene seguro o paga de su bolsillo, y pregunte sobre un descuento por dificultad financiera o un plan de pago.

es.question: Cual es la diferencia entre el costo de aborto en un hospital y en una clinica independiente en Virginia?
es.answer: En Virginia en 2026, una clinica independiente de salud reproductiva cobra de $600 a $900 por un aborto quirurgico en el primer trimestre, mientras que un departamento ambulatorio del hospital cobra de $1,500 a $3,500 por el mismo procedimiento. La tarifa mas alta del hospital incluye gastos generales de instalacion, modelos de personal y facturacion como proveedor hospitalario que las clinicas independientes no tienen. El aborto con medicamentos en una clinica independiente cuesta de $350 a $650; en un departamento ambulatorio del hospital puede superar $1,000. La calidad del procedimiento es equivalente.

es.question: Cubre el seguro ACA de Virginia el aborto en 2026?
es.answer: Virginia no tiene una ley estatal que exija ni prohiba la cobertura del aborto en planes ACA. La cobertura queda a criterio de los aseguradores individuales. A partir de 2026, al menos un plan en el mercado de Virginia incluye cobertura para el aborto, pero la mayoria no lo hace. Los creditos fiscales federales de prima no pueden aplicarse a la porcion de una prima atribuible a la cobertura del aborto. Si tiene un plan ACA, revise el documento Resumen de Beneficios y Cobertura del plan o llame a servicios para miembros para confirmar si el aborto esta cubierto.

es.question: Cual es la diferencia entre el aborto con medicamentos y el aborto quirurgico en Virginia?
es.answer: El aborto con medicamentos (pastilla) utiliza mifepristona seguida de misoprostol para terminar un embarazo y esta disponible en Virginia hasta las 10 a 12 semanas de gestacion, ya sea por telehealth o en una visita de clinica en persona. El costo en Virginia en 2026 es de $350 a $650. El aborto quirurgico utiliza aspiracion (aspiracion al vacio) en el primer trimestre o legrado por evacuacion (LEC) en el segundo trimestre. Los costos quirurgicos en Virginia van de $600 en el primer trimestre temprano a $2,600 a las 18 a 22 semanas.

es.question: Que asistencia financiera esta disponible para el aborto en Virginia en 2026?
es.answer: Varias organizaciones brindan asistencia financiera directa para el aborto en Virginia en 2026. El Blue Ridge Abortion Fund (blueridgeabortionfund.org) atiende a pacientes en Virginia desde 1989 y proporciona financiamiento, transporte y asistencia para alojamiento. El Richmond Reproductive Freedom Project (rrfp.net) asiste a pacientes de Virginia con costos del procedimiento, transporte, alojamiento, comidas y ultrasonidos, atendiendo a mas de 250 pacientes al ano. Planned Parenthood Virginia League y Falls Church Healthcare Center ofrecen tarifas en escala movil basadas en ingresos. Contacte a los fondos de aborto temprano en el proceso porque los fondos son limitados.
